About

A free, no-frills place to drill Japanese vocabulary for English speakers. Everything is a simple flashcard: tap to flip between the Japanese word and its English meaning and reading.

How it works

Pick a JLPT level (N5 is the easiest, N1 the hardest) or the phrases set. Each page shows every word as a card. Tap a card to reveal the meaning, kana reading and romaji. Use “Show all meanings” to flip the whole set at once for a quick review.

What’s inside

  • JLPT N5–N1 vocabulary — graded by difficulty.
  • Survival phrases — practical set phrases for daily life.

Readings and romaji

Every card shows the kana reading and Hepburn romaji, so you can study even before you are fully comfortable with kanji.
